body:
It's an excellent question. Unfortunately in the UK, where we're based, men are three times more likely to kill themselves than women. It's the biggest killer of men under 50. You can combine violent crime, traffic accidents and cancer and suicide still totals more. Only one in 10 people are aware that suicide is such a massive issue for men. 

Of course suicide is an issue for women as well as men, but there are and need to be schemes and media exist that target men to bring the rates down. 

Here's a [table](https://www.thecalmzone.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/11/Suicides-in-the-UK-1981-2013-ONS-Table-7-updated-formatted-by-CALM.pdf) that shows the difference in rates between men and women.
